Summary.en: Adds a Google reCAPTCHA check to protect the form from bots.
Summary.de: Fügt eine Google-reCAPTCHA-Prüfung hinzu, um das Formular vor Bots zu schützen.
Summary.it: Aggiunge una verifica Google reCAPTCHA per proteggere il modulo dai bot.

Parameter.DataCallback: The optional global callback method for when the captcha provides a result.
Parameter.DataCallbackCode: Optional code to be executed when the captcha provides a result.

DataCallback.default: The optional global callback method for when the captcha provides a result.

DataCallbackCode.default: Optional code to be executed when the captcha provides a result.
